## 主张 Claim

在有限非空的合格接续中，若每种缺少某项组织关系的接续都有充分更好的合格构造，则所有未被击败的选择都包含该关系；这可支持建设或增强共同能力而不预定唯一承载。 / In a finite nonempty eligible range, if every continuation lacking an organizational relation has a strictly better eligible construction, every undefeated choice includes that relation. This can warrant building or strengthening shared capacity without fixing one carrier.

Canonical source: [ETHICAL-LEARNING.md](../../unified-2026-10-05/ETHICAL-LEARNING.md)

同一支持历史形成连接、保留基础并承担休闲损失；甲乙是作用路径。具体模型的合格谓词只表示物理可行，不能独自认证现实权限。 / One support history forms links, retains a basis and bears an opportunity loss; the two carriers are routes. Concrete eligibility means physical feasibility only and does not certify real authority.
